data.one_liner: Generates Hive TypeAdapter code for Dart classes automatically.
data.what_it_does: The package scans annotated classes and creates the boiler‑plate TypeAdapter needed by Hive to serialize and deserialize objects. It integrates with build_runner to produce Dart files during build time.
use_when: You need type‑safe, performant local storage with Hive and want to avoid writing adapters manually
You are already using Hive and want a zero‑maintenance way to keep adapters in sync with model changes
avoid_when: You prefer a runtime reflection‑based solution instead of code generation
Your project does not use Hive for storage
strengths: Supports null‑safety, inheritance, default values, and various field types
Works with build_runner and stays up‑to‑date with Hive versions
weaknesses: Requires build_runner step in CI/build process
Only works with Hive; not a generic serialization solution
data.setup_notes: Add hive_generator and build_runner to dev_dependencies, annotate classes with @HiveType/@HiveField, then run `flutter pub run build_runner build`.
